steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each requirement is matched to a fair criterion. A requirement that is not job-related is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 requirement is not related to the job

findings.title: Requirement not related to the job
findings.fix: Remove the requirement or justify it

findings.title: Requirement with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the requirement

outcome.notChecked: Whether the role's requirements are the right ones.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).

       Fix: Remove the requirement or justify it.
[medium] jd-role-d.md:19  Requirement with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the requirement.
[low] jd-role-f.md:26  Responsibility with no criterion.

Not checked: Whether the role's requirements are the right ones.
pros: Checks each such requirement with its exact text.
cons: Not checked: Whether the role's requirements are the right ones.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-job-description skill on the records for this review.
